minutes.headline: Commission approved the contested Fire Road 16 house on a re-vote; Holmen Street lot 1 vote tied and failed.
minutes.summary: Long remote Conservation Commission meeting with many hearings, mostly continued to June 2. It dropped an enforcement action on Leominster Road, tied on conditional approval of a seven-lot Holmen Street subdivision, and approved the contested Fire Road 16 notice of intent after redoing the vote to take public comment. It also argued over whether to send a recommendation on member reappointments to the select board, approved land use form edits and approved prior minutes.

public_comment.topic: Andrea Adams asked whether the 101 Pleasant Street applicants were seeking an extension.
Urged the commission to make a recommendation to the select board supporting the associate member and the reapplying member.
Andrea Adams praised the Holmen Street design and asked who maintains the drainage structures.
Andrea Adams objected that public comment was not taken before the Fire Road 16 vote and urged members to stick to their positions.
Said the planning board granted vital access for the Fire Road 16 project, possibly with conditions.
Andrea Adams explained her address and why she attends.

Hunting and signage on conservation land to be a future agenda item.
No recommendation on select board appointments was voted.

what_happened.line: The commission approved the contested Fire Road 16 notice of intent, with a waiver for the driveway and no further work in the 50 foot zone except a dock.
An amendment to make the Fire Road 16 approval pending planning board conditions failed on a 3-3 tie, and the motion was then re-voted as a whole.
The vote to approve Holmen Street lot 1, conditional on planning and stormwater approval, failed 3-3, so all seven lots were continued to June 2.
The commission dropped the Leominster Road enforcement action and will hear the request for determination next meeting.
No recommendation on select board appointments was voted, after debate on reappointing members.

why_it_matters: The Fire Road 16 approval allows a house to proceed near a protected buffer, with the planning board's access conditions still bearing on the project.
The tie on Holmen Street lot 1 leaves a seven-lot subdivision undecided, so residents near it and those asking who maintains its drainage will see it return on June 2.
watch_next: Holmen Street's seven notices of intent, 90 Rue Street and Fire Road 12 return on June 2.
